c.tagline: A French-Pacific city wrapped around the world's largest lagoon.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis are scarce and must usually be booked by phone rather than hailed on the street; there is no Uber or ride-hailing app, so most visitors rely on hotel transfers or a rental car.

emergency.note: As in mainland France, dial 15 for medical (SAMU), 17 for police and 18 for fire; 112 works from any mobile phone.

avoid.reason: Civil unrest since 2024 (pro-independence tensions) — roadblocks and flare-ups possible; check advisories

hood_desc: Nouméa's main resort beach, lined with hotels, the aquarium, restaurants and the Palm Beach complex; a breezy windsurf and kite bay that is the default tourist base.
A sheltered swimming beach backed by a strip of bars, clubs and restaurants — the city's nightlife and sundowner hub, walkable to Anse Vata.
The downtown core around the palm-shaded Place des Cocotiers, the Port Moselle municipal market, cathedral and museums; the convenient, walkable heart of the city.
A mid-town bay between the beaches and downtown with a marina, waterfront apartments and a shopping centre; calm and residential with easy access both ways.
An old hillside residential neighbourhood of colonial houses just above the centre and marina; quiet and local, with harbour views.

water.note: Tap water in Nouméa is treated and safe to drink.

transit.pay: The Tanéo network (formerly Karuïa Bus) is paid with a rechargeable Tanéo card or cash to the driver; a single ride is a few hundred CFP francs. There is no rail, metro or tram.
transit.hours: Buses run mainly daytime and early evening on weekdays with sparse weekend service, so a rental car is far more practical for exploring.
transit.note: Nouméa's only public transport is the Tanéo bus network covering the peninsula and Greater Nouméa; service is limited, so most visitors rely on rental cars, taxis or hotel transfers.

bus: RAI intercity buses to other Grande Terre towns
ferry: Gare Maritime (Betico ferry to Île des Pins & Loyalty Islands)

transit.m: Navette Aéroport shuttle bus to Nouméa centre, about 1 hr

tip.r: Tipping is not part of French/Kanak custom and service is included; rounding up for exceptional service is optional.
